title: Evaluate Technology Options
prompt:
Compare these technology options for our use case:

Decision to make: [WHAT WE'RE CHOOSING — e.g., message queue, ORM, frontend framework]
Our context:
- Team experience: [languages/tools team knows]
- Scale: [current and projected]
- Timeline: [how fast we need to ship]
- Budget: [OSS only / cloud cost constraints]
- Operational maturity: [who will run this in production]

Options to evaluate:
1. [OPTION A]
2. [OPTION B]
3. [OPTION C]

## Comparison Matrix
| Criterion | Option A | Option B | Option C | Weight |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Learning curve | | | | 15% |
| Performance at our scale | | | | 20% |
| Community/ecosystem | | | | 10% |
| Operational complexity | | | | 20% |
| Long-term support | | | | 15% |
| Cost | | | | 10% |
| Fit with our stack | | | | 10% |
| **Weighted Score** | | | | 100% |

## Deep Dive: Key Differences
The most important differences that will affect our daily work:
[Focus on practical differences, not spec sheet comparisons]

## Recommendation
**Choose [OPTION X]** because [2–3 specific reasons tied to our context].

The main tradeoff we're making: we're accepting [downside] in exchange for [benefit].

Don't choose this if: [specific scenario where this recommendation is wrong]
